name: Oral Biology PhD with Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics Certificate
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Combined research doctorate and orthodontic residency for qualified dental graduates; the PhD cannot be entered independently.

publishedDeadlines.label: Combined residency application
publishedDeadlines.note: Program-specific date has no stated entry year; do not substitute general graduate-directory dates.

applicationFee.note: Central international Graduate College application $95 (domestic $60). Separate ADEA PASS application is required; PASS and combined-residency fees not established. Do not apply to Graduate College until selected by the program.

english.toefl: 80 legacy; 4.0 current scale, no band below 3.5
english.note: Central Graduate College minimum; program also requires proficiency in English. IELTS no band below 6, DET no band below 100. English-medium postsecondary degree may exempt with proof of instruction language. Confirm dental-program requirements. Scores under two years at application.

documents: ADEA PASS application with specified recommendation letters (number not stated)
Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent evidence
requirements.note: Requires CODA-accredited US/Canadian DMD/DDS, passed National Dental Board PartsI/II or INBDE, bachelor’s or equivalent and eligibility for Nevada dental licensure before clinical activity.60 month combined program begins July; not an independently accessible bioscience PhD. Dissertation defense and major research project required.

international.note: Official page explicitly instructs domestic and international applicants; US/Canadian accredited dental degree and licensure restrictions still apply.
